post.description:
Issue a new MCP agent token.

Generates a high-entropy random token, stores only its SHA-256 hash,
and returns the plaintext exactly once. The plaintext is never logged.
Issuing an access credential requires a valid single-use
re-authentication token, like the revoke path.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request (for auth guard).
    label: Human-readable label for the token (e.g. "claude").
    capability: Token capability — "read" or "read-write".
    reauth_token: Single-use reauth token from X-Reauth-Token header.
    cred: Credential Proxy client.
    reauth_mgr: Re-authentication manager.

Returns:
    Dict with "label" and "token" (plaintext, shown once).

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 without a valid reauth token, 422 on invalid
        capability, 409 if the label already exists.

schema.title: Response Issue Agent Token Admin Agents Issue Post

get.description:
List all configured MCP agent tokens (metadata only).

schema.title: Response List Agent Tokens Admin Agents List Get

delete.description:
Revoke an MCP agent token by label.

Deletes the corresponding ``mcp_agent`` integration so the token no longer
authenticates. Requires a valid single-use re-authentication token, and
only ever deletes an ``mcp_agent`` integration — never a non-agent
integration that happens to share the same name.

Args:
    request: FastAPI request (for auth guard).
    label: The label of the token to revoke.
    reauth_token: Single-use reauth token from X-Reauth-Token header.
    cred: Credential Proxy client.
    reauth_mgr: Re-authentication manager.

Returns:
    204 without a body.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 403 without a valid reauth token, 404 if no agent token
        with that label exists.

get.description:
Read file content.

Starlette's FileResponse does not evaluate If-None-Match, so the
conditional check is explicit: the ETag is computed with the same
stat-based formula FileResponse uses and set on the response
itself, so a matching If-None-Match yields a 304 with an empty body.

Args:
    file_id: File UUID.
    request: HTTP request (provides the If-None-Match header).
    _claims: Authenticated user.
    admin: DB Proxy client.

Returns:
    File content with appropriate Content-Type and
    Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400; 304 when the conditional
    header matches the ETag.

Raises:
    HTTPException: 404 if the file is missing from the database or disk.

get.description:
List files and directories in the workspace.

Args:
    path: Relative path within workspace (empty = root).
    request: Authenticated request (validated by _require_auth).

Returns:
    List of items with name, type (file/dir), size, and path.
